RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY from exact_* fields nested in layout_and_content_blocks and connections. Preserve every Chinese character, punctuation mark and explicit line break.
All containers and panels have WHITE #FFFFFF fill. Colored borders only. Do not render metadata, block IDs, source references, caption_note or completeness text.
Use only #1B3A5C and #2E6B9E as chromatic colors; all text is #333333; anchors/arrows #4D4D4D; diagnostics #616161.
Final physical width is 155mm. Chinese labels must remain 8.5–10pt after insertion. Delete optional secondary text before reducing font size.
Each major block must have the specified small geometric anchor or numbered outline marker, composed of editable lines/rectangles/circles.
No decorative pictograms, weather illustrations, waveform plots, heatmap values, performance numbers, success ticks or sample-result curves.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning icons, NO 3D rendering; no gradients, shadows, color-filled modules or raster textures.
Forward data flow uses solid arrows; label/score feedback uses dashed arrows. Draw no unintended connection between separated branches.
No invented dimensions, neural layers, trainable/frozen badges, tensors, station names, coordinates, cooperation logos or experimental outcomes.
Long formulas, parameters, limitations and F-XJ references belong in caption_note, never as unapproved on-figure text.

caption_note: 图名：C1 可用气象信息与跨尺度增益路线。数据授权与时间核验后，仅使用发布时刻之前已获取的信息；历史窗口分解不使用未来测试值。
同容量、同训练预算比较逐源增加、去除尺度与固定融合，变量和尺度仅在训练与历史验证中选择；测试用于独立评价。该图仅为研究设计，不展示实测波形、性能或已完成成果。
NWP的起报、有效和实际获取时刻须分别保留；卫星考虑处理延迟。未来实况与ERA5仅用于明示的离线描述或理想输入对照，不接主预测通路。
F-XJ-01/02仍待新疆实测授权与业务NWP档案落实。无NWP可用历史观测开展短时研究，未获新疆实测不能声称完成地域验证。
相关与尺度增益是待检验的预测关系，不是已识别的物理因果机制；具体变量、采样和分解参数以真实资料确认。
